note: Set A captures top thickness (0.019 m) and several correct table rows, but it misbinds the 80.8 GPa shear modulus as a "yield strength" and gives the bending/torsional stiffness units as N*m^3 instead of the table's N*m^2 in three claims (TwGJStif, two TwFAStif entries), plus a couple of altered quotes. Set B correctly reports the shear modulus, the 30% thickness increase, the 7,850 kg/m3 baseline density and TMassDen values, but it invents two table entries (TwFAlSef 218.3 N/m and TwFASStiff 614.5 N*m^2) with quotes that appear nowhere on the page and puts TwSSIner 4688.0 in Row 10 when it belongs to the 87.60 m row. Counting all misread/misbound/invented claims, B has fewer errors (3 vs 4) and covers more of the paragraph's key facts, though its two fabrications are the most severe individual failures in either set.
